'''April 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Jose, California on 8 April 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d503">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-san-jose-california-4-8d503/ san-jose-california-4-8], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 11 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-san-jose-california-4-8d503/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000
* '''Site:''' San Jose, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
